addToPot(uint8,uint32).notice: House adds and bounty seeds: anyone may put money in.

bountyFloor(uint8).notice: A posted target the first claim must beat. Lets the house advertise a real bar ("beat 12,000") without faking a run to set one, which is the only other way to raise a record from zero. Visible on chain, only ever set by the authority.

insertCoin(uint8,bytes32).notice: One quarter: pays the price, splits it, and records a seed-committed credit.

openTab(address,uint256).notice: Deposit a pack; `sessionFloat` of it is forwarded to the session key for its gas.

setPayoutTable(uint16[]).notice: New payout table for pots that open from now on. 1-10 ranks, summing to 10000 bps.

setSponsor(uint8,address,address,uint16).notice: Sponsor a cabinet: `buybackBps` of every quarter (≤ the house share) accrues for `vault`.

startRun(address,uint8,bytes32).notice: From a tab, by the session key: no popup, same money flow.

withdrawBuyback(uint8).notice: The vault pulls what has accrued, swaps it for the sponsor token, and pays the winner.
